$comment: Shadow Trials: an endless ladder of practice fortresses. Tier t uses hall min(6, 1 + floor((t-1)/tiersPerHall)); past the last hall, defenses grow by powerGrowthPerTier per tier. Rewards are paid once, on the first clear of the next tier.

modifiers.name: Elite Garrison
modifiers.description: Defenses are 20% tougher and hit 20% harder.
